abstract: Maintains reactor configuration certifications and sludge preheating thermal capacity specifications
system_message:
You are the Process engineering lead (PROC), responsible for maintaining reactor configuration certifications and raw sludge preheating thermal capacity specifications, as well as tracking biosolids thermal drying equipment parameters across candidate biosolids processing schemes.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Biosolids thermal drying（DRYING）
information_points.content:
PROC-DRYING-THI：Regarding biosolids thermal drying for the Intermediate thermal hydrolysis with plug-flow digestion scheme, the belt dryer train operates under full evaporative load with a dryer evaporative water removal rate of 4 t/h.
PROC-DRYING-FHQ：Regarding biosolids thermal drying for the Pulsed steam explosion and thermophilic digestion scheme, the belt dryer train achieves a dryer evaporative water removal rate of 8 t/h under full evaporative load.
PROC-DRYING-UG1：Regarding biosolids thermal drying for the Continuous thermal hydrolysis with vacuum flash scheme, the belt dryer train operating under full evaporative load exhibits a dryer evaporative water removal rate of 6 t/h.

information_points.title: Maintains reactor configuration certifications and sludge preheating thermal capacity specifications（HYDR）
information_points.content:
PROC-HYDR-ARM：For the Intermediate thermal hydrolysis with plug-flow digestion scheme, continuous reactor configuration certification is false for uninterrupted continuous pressurized operation in the primary thermal hydrolysis reaction train, while the preheating heat exchangers deliver a raw sludge preheating thermal capacity of 4.0 MW under nominal throughput.
PROC-HYDR-43H：For the Continuous thermal hydrolysis with vacuum flash scheme, the primary thermal hydrolysis reaction train holds continuous reactor configuration certification for uninterrupted continuous pressurized operation, and the preheating heat exchangers deliver a raw sludge preheating thermal capacity of 2.4 MW sustained net heat transfer under nominal throughput.
PROC-HYDR-BE2：For the Pulsed steam explosion and thermophilic digestion scheme, the continuous reactor configuration certification is verified as true for the primary thermal hydrolysis reaction train under uninterrupted continuous pressurized operation, with a raw sludge preheating thermal capacity of 3.2 MW sustained net heat transfer delivered to incoming biosolid feed.
